cases.name: Laverne Moye
cases.narrative:
On 7/20/1972, her body was found in a creek in Rockville Centre, NY. 

Cottingham claimed to have thrown her body from Rockville Center's Peninsula Boulevard Bridge.

cases.name: Mary Beth Heinz
cases.narrative:
On 5/10/1972, her body was discovered near a creek in Rockville Centre, NY. She had cuts on her face and neck from being strangled. She had vanished on 5/5/1972 as she boarded a bus to travel to a nearby dance. 

Cottingham claimed to have thrown her body from Rockville Center's Peninsula Boulevard Bridge.
